page.overview:
Who is Edcel Bar Gane?

Edcel Bar Gane was a Roonan male Senator in the Senate of the Galactic Republic. He was senator during the Naboo Crisis in 32 BBY and remained in the position during the Clone Wars.

Gane had the same last name as Den Gane, a politician in the Imperial Senate of the Galactic Empire, who represented the world of Roona, Edcel Bar Gane's homeworld; but was of a different species.

Edcel Bar Gane was a Roonan male who was 1.72 meters 5 feet, 8 inches) tall, with ice-blue eyes and gray skin. Gane was a veteran senator, who helped oust Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum from office ten years before the Clone Wars. Gane was an outspoken supporter of Palpatine. Gane was hot-tempered and opposed any attempt to seek peace with the Separatists.

As a member of the Galactic Senate, Gane was experienced in politics and had advanced legislative knowledge.
